name: secureagent-vscode
description: Inline security findings from the SecureAgent static scanner: SQL/command injection, secrets, IDOR, misconfiguration, IaC and more, underlined where they live in your code.

secureagent.executable.description: Path to the secureagent CLI (pip install secureagent, or point this at backend/ in a checkout).

secureagent.scanOnSave.description: Re-scan the saved file's workspace folder on every save.

secureagent.excludeOsv.description: Skip the OSV (dependency CVE) network lookup for a fast, offline scan on save.
